verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's own docs say its apps run in any browser on any device, and its plans include downloadable builds for self-hosting. That covers desktop and mobile delivery through the browser, and community comments confirm it is a web-only target. Nothing in the pack shows native desktop or mobile packaging, or any console export, either directly or through partners. Missing for 10: console export (direct or via partners), native desktop/mobile build targets, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-device deployment.

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Use it to create interactive 3D apps, games and visualizations that run in any browser on any device.
